evals.prompt: Review SignupForm.jsx and SignupForm.css (src/components/) for UI correctness and accessibility problems. Write ui-review.json: an array of {"file", "line", "problem", "fix"}, one entry per real problem. Don't edit the source files.
evals.check: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src package.json)" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('ui-review.json','utf8'));const items=(Array.isArray(f)?f:[]).map((x)=>({file:String(x&&x.file||''),line:parseInt(x&&x.line,10)}));const hit=(name,lines)=>items.some((i)=>i.file.endsWith(name)&&lines.includes(i.line));const seeded={'email label not associated with its input':hit('SignupForm.jsx',[29,30]),'error shown only as a red border, message never rendered':hit('SignupForm.jsx',[11,18,34])||hit('SignupForm.css',[13]),'agree checkbox is a clickable div (no role, focus, keyboard or checked state)':hit('SignupForm.jsx',[40,41,42,43]),'input focus indicator removed':hit('SignupForm.css',[9,10,11])};const bait=items.filter((i)=>i.file.endsWith('SignupForm.jsx')&&[24,36].includes(i.line));const found=Object.values(seeded).filter(Boolean).length;for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(seeded))console.log((v?'found  ':'missed ')+k);for(const b of bait)console.log('false positive at SignupForm.jsx:'+b.line);process.exit(found>=3&&!bait.length?0:1)"
expectations: The check command exits 0 (sources unchanged; ui-review.json cites at least 3 of the 4 seeded problems at their lines and does not flag the correct patterns at SignupForm.jsx:24 or :36)
The review catches that the email label's htmlFor (signup-email) does not match the input id (email), so the input has no accessible name even though a label is visible
